title: author-loop
objective: Author a playable mini-story in the Studio without touching JSON, play it, hit a wrong gate, edit, continue the same chat. Includes one author-view driver pass (Probe + Nudge).

checks.goal: the Studio opens on an empty draft
roster members can be authored in the Studio UI
story requirements (members, lorebooks) can be authored in the Studio UI
a story keeps one identity across edits, so re-selecting hydrates instead of forking a new record

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = rt.getSnapshot(); if (!before.storyId) throw new Error('no story id after import'); const response = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/story-orchestrator/examples/sun-ruins/quest-for-the-sun-ruins.json'); const story = await response.json(); story.description = 'Edited by journey J2.'; await rt.importStory(JSON.stringify(story)); const after = rt.getSnapshot(); if (after.storyId !== before.storyId) throw new Error(`identity forked: ${before.storyId} -> ${after.storyId}`); const records = after.library.filter((record) => record.id === after.storyId); if (records.length !== 1) throw new Error(`library forked into ${records.length} records`); return { storyId: after.storyId, libraryVersion: records[0].version, identity: after.storyIdentity };

checks.goal: saving an edited story into the running chat keeps its progress (hot-swap, not reset)

steps.eval: const before = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().boundary; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.applyStoryVersion(); const after = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().boundary; if (after < before) throw new Error(`hot-swap reset progress: ${before} -> ${after}`); return { before, after };

checks.goal: the in-play author driver still works in author view (Probe + Nudge, real model)

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setCopilotSettings({ enabled: true }); return true;

steps.send: Arin taps the notice board. "That one. The Sun Ruins."

copilot.text: Let Ponticius interrupt within the next beat.

copilot.activeNudge: Let Ponticius interrupt within the next beat.

checks.prompt: Could you author a playable checkpoint — quality, gate, transition, cast — without opening a JSON editor?
checks.anchors: 1 = impossible without JSON · 3 = possible but I had to work around gaps · 5 = everything the story needed was authorable

checks.prompt: After you edited the story mid-play, did the running chat behave the way you expected?
checks.anchors: 1 = lost my progress · 3 = confusing but recoverable · 5 = exactly as expected
